newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BFE, BPI share suspension to be lifted at 1100 GMT.
newsitem.headline: BFE, BPI share suspension to be lifted at 1100 GMT.

text.p: A suspension of trading in shares of Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) and Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE) will be lifted at 1100 GMT, Portugal's Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) said.
The Lisbon bourse announced earlier that BPI offered 2,615 escudos per share in its successful bid for 65 percent of state-controlled BFE.
Both banks' shares have been suspended since last week. BFE was last quoted at 2,545 escudos and BPI at 2,115.
